name: Chapter 14: the Catacombs (new monsters, souls and Charlotte's spell)
summary: Circle of the Moon enemies as real HoD enemies in their own DLC-style code modules, packed with the stage designer's chapter as one official-style chapter package: the Poison Worm, Cerberus (boss) and the Skeleton Bomber, their Soma souls, and Charlotte's Lightning Orb.
state: Test install only. Poison Worm and its small worms, Cerberus (all attacks and sounds), Cerberus's soul and Charlotte's Lightning Orb confirmed in game. Skeleton Bomber and its soul built, untested. The worm soul's drop rate is still the test value 1000.

features.runtime_switch: its code lives in its own modules, which load only from package 10

cmake_option: HARMONYRECOMP_POISONWORM (test-install builds only; also makes the exe use the userdata folder next to it)

contents: the stage designer's chapter (renumbered from the editor's package 31 to 10, chapter number 14)
data/enemy/EnemyParam10.dat rows (Compendium keys 146-164, spilling into package 11's block)
dll/enemy/DLL_Cm068.dll (Cerberus, from Legion's DLL_Region, base 0x8BF00000; replaces Legion as the chapter boss)
dll/enemy/DLL_Cm007.dll (Skeleton Bomber, from DLL_FCbat, base 0x89400000; replaces every Nova Skeleton in the chapter)
dll/shot/dllshotCm050w.dll (small worms, 0x85780000), dllshotCm068.dll (Cerberus orbs and bolts, 0x85800000), dllshotCm007.dll (bombs, 0x85980000)
soulset_dlc10 / learningset rows, text, enemy sprites and Compendium pictures, VX_ENEMY_CERBERUS sound bank
Arma Custos (mods/glyphs): glyph 9 row, text, head art, Cerberus boss-chest entry

native.own_overrides: module-internal functions only (listed in docs/HOOKS.md); no exe hooks

claims.package: 10 (enemy keys need a package <= 20: key = 0x38 + (package - 1) * 10 + row indexes the save's kill counters, which end at 256)
claims.souls: 116 Poison Worm (item 0x6E7), 117 Cerberus (0x6E8), 118 Skeleton Bomber (0x6E9); next 119

user_inputs: Circle of the Moon ROM (sprites, effects; sounds rendered with agbplay)
The stage designer's chapter (.hodchapter from the HoD Level Editor), placed in the test install's stage folder
Official DLC used as code/sprite templates: 8-bit DLC package 04 (B7ED140B...) and Chapter 8 package 02 (9CF52007...)
build: python mods/catacombs/tools/poison_worm_module.py codegen   (and cerberus_module.py, cerberus_shot.py, cerberus_soul.py, skeleton_bomber.py, skeleton_bomber_soul.py: each rebases its module and runs code generation)
python mods/catacombs/tools/catacombs_dlc.py install        (package 10 into the test install)
